#include <vector>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1LL) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    vector<int> seen((size_t)p, 0);
    ll ans = 1;

    auto walk = [&](int start) {
        int cur = start;
        int cnt = 0;
        do {
            seen[cur] = 1;
            ++cnt;
            cur = (int)((ll)cur * k % p);
        } while (!seen[cur]);
        return cnt;
    };

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!seen[i]) {
            int siz = walk(i);
            ll t = mod_pow(k, siz, p);
            if (t != 1 && t != 0)
                ans = ans * (siz + 1) % MOD;
            else
                ans = ans * p % MOD;
        }
    }

    if (k == 1) ans = ans * p % MOD;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
